description: Curated LLM fixture scenarios for tests and demos. Add new scenarios by appending an entry below and committing the file. Scenarios are looked up by (request_type, scenario_id). Use scenario_id 'default' for the fallback when no explicit scenario is provided in the request.

proposals.body: Demo fixture: Executive department stabilizes logistics on the contested Mars corridor. Recommends rerouting 90 credits into emergency supply convoys with milestone reporting at turn end.
proposals.title: Mars Corridor Logistics Stabilization

proposals.body: Demo fixture: Research bureau proposes a bounded sprint on adaptive shielding informed by recent skirmish telemetry. Expected payoff: a doctrine option unlocking by turn 10.
proposals.title: Adaptive Shielding Sprint

proposals.body: Turn 8 judge scenario: Defense officer recommends pre-positioning reserve fleet near Callisto to lock the opportunity window before the opponent reacts. Cost is bounded to preserve commander credit float.
proposals.title: Callisto Pre-Positioning Order

proposals.body: Turn 8 judge scenario: Industry pushes a Jupiter foundry expansion to convert idle capacity into a ship-grade fabrication queue. Pairs cleanly with the Callisto order above.
proposals.title: Jupiter Foundry Expansion

proposals.body: Turn 8 judge scenario: Research bureau flags a quick win to publish a public doctrine signal that nudges opponent confidence reporting. Low cost, narrative flourish.
proposals.title: Doctrine Signaling Publication

response.headline: Daily Operations Brief
response.prose: Fixture inbox: Executive officer reports steady supply and an approved logistics initiative. No decision required this turn.

response.headline: Resolution Pulse
response.prose: Fixture narrative: A quiet shift over the Belt. Drone patrols complete their rotation without incident. The newsroom prepares a standard briefing for the commander.

response.headline: Colony Arrival
response.prose: Fixture narrative: Your colony ship completes docking at Callisto. Ground crews report nominal life-support and begin establishment-phase construction immediately.

response.headline: Resume Briefing - Standby
response.prose: Fixture resume: Last session ended on turn 5 with both colonies stable. Pending proposals are queued for review.
